summary: Iteration 6 - Verified new auth features: landing page, JWT register/login/logout/me, forgot/reset password, protected routes, and user-scoped research. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests PASSED in test_auth_flows.py (100%). Frontend: Playwright end-to-end verified landing hero+Vision+Mission cards, unauth redirect from /dashboard and /history to /login, registration creates user and lands on /dashboard, UserMenu shows name and logout returns to /, admin login works, forgot-password success screen renders, /reset-password without token shows 'Invalid reset link' and with token shows form, wrong password shows 'Invalid email or password' error.

minor.issue: pydantic EmailStr rejects .test/.local TLDs - not a bug per se, but test emails must use example.com
FastAPI on_event deprecated; use lifespan handler (carryover)

issues: Footer still says 'Powered by CrewAI + GPT-5.2 Thinking' but Fast Mode uses gpt-4o-mini (carryover from iter 5)

action_items: (Optional) Migrate FastAPI on_event to lifespan handler
(Optional) Update landing footer copy to reflect actual model used
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: get_current_user uses ObjectId(payload['sub']) but never handles InvalidId exception - malformed sub would raise bson.errors.InvalidId as 500 rather than 401.
auth.py logout endpoint requires authentication (Depends(get_current_user)) - if access_token expired, logout returns 401 and cookies never clear. Consider clearing cookies regardless.

server.py get_research_session (GET /research/{id}) is NOT protected - any user (or anon) can fetch any session by ID including other users' data. Export endpoints (markdown/json/pdf/latex/docx) similarly unauthenticated.
server.py: SSE /research/stream/{session_id} has no auth and no ownership check.
Cookies use samesite='none' + secure=true which requires HTTPS - works on preview but will break on plain http localhost dev.
App.js still monolithic (~1360 lines); LandingPage was extracted but Dashboard/HistoryPage remain in App.js.
seed_data_creation: test_auth_flows.py creates several test_<uuid>@example.com users on each run. No cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth uses httpOnly cookies (access_token 60m + refresh_token 7d) with samesite='none' secure=true. All /api/auth/* endpoints tested and working. Admin seed idempotent (updates password if changed). Bcrypt hash. Test emails MUST use example.com (pydantic EmailStr rejects .test/.local). CRITICAL SECURITY GAP: GET /api/research/{session_id}, GET /api/research/{session_id}/export/*, and GET /api/research/stream/{session_id} are NOT auth-protected, so any user with a session_id can read/export another user's research. Only POST /api/research/start, GET /api/research (list), and DELETE /api/research/{id} enforce auth+scoping. This should be flagged to E1 as high-priority.
rca of the issue: N/A - all requested features working. Security gaps in read/export/stream endpoints are pre-existing (not part of new auth wiring).
